dialogue.text: Pins are the main collectible around these parts.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text:
Most common way to obtain pins is by buying boxes
on the other half of the counter.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text:
Some might have more specific requirements to unlock,<d=0.25/>
so check your pin board for a hint on how to obtain them.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text:
You kind of just collect them for the sake of it.<d=0.75/>
They don't do anything.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Couldn't call them pointless if the contrary was true.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia
